name: astra-runtime-manager
description: Check CLI/CPU compatibility, measure usage, and manage desktop or standalone experimental Astra runtimes.

interface.shortDescription: Check compatibility, measure usage, and manage tested runtimes.
interface.longDescription: Portable diagnostics and usage reports, standalone CLI setup, and guarded experimental builds for cataloged releases on x86-64/ARM64 macOS, Linux, and Windows. Runtime behavior must pass local validation; universal release compatibility and savings are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Check my CLI compatibility and Astra runtime status.
Compare my before and after token usage.
Set up and enable the supported Astra runtime.
